The '''Galactic Gourmet's Galaxy Guide''' was a publication detailing the varying foods of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and advising the reader where to eat on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. One planet it contained a section on was [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], who's food it claimed tasted reconstituted and was to strongly flavoured with additives and the spice [[lill]].
